description: A close-up view of a computer motherboard with a prominent central processing unit (CPU) in the middle. The CPU is highlighted with a glowing red hue, creating a striking contrast against the dark, intricate circuitry of the motherboard. The surrounding components, including capacitors and other microchips, are visible, with a warm orange light reflecting off their surfaces, adding depth and dimension to the scene. The focus is sharp on the CPU and its connecting pins, while the background elements gradually blur, emphasizing the central component. The overall color scheme is dominated by dark tones with vibrant red and orange highlights, giving the image a futuristic and high-tech feel.
